nodes.description: For every compact Hausdorff simply connected topological three-manifold, choose a compatible atlas on its existing topology and supply the matching analytic, surgery, decomposition, finite trace, and Perelman production data.

Construct a covering map from the standard three-sphere to a manifold equipped with a GroundedTopologySource. The geometric interpretation of its component carriers and their neck/cap gluing remains open; a partition of the original point set does not supply this covering.
Checked conditional reduction: choose the presentation atlas, pass its complete source to the assumed covering constructor, and apply simply connected covering rigidity.
Every compact Hausdorff simply connected topological three-manifold is homeomorphic to the standard three-sphere. This exact declaration remains absent.
